title: Molongi Kati Na Ba Horizons Mibale
intro: Na ba annals ya bokambi ya bonzambe, elilingi moko etelemi mosika lokola mokonzi ya nguya mpe mosaleli ya komikitisa ya Allah. Moto yango asalaki mobembo tii na bisika oyo eleki mosika na mabele, amonaki moi kobima likoló ya bato oyo bazalaki momeseno te mpe kolala na liziba moko ya moindo oyo ezalaki na molili. Likambo ya kokamwa mingi, mosaleli yango azwaki mokumba ya kotonga epekiseli moko ya kokamwa mpo na kobundisa ekólo oyo ezalaki na mobulu monene. Okoki koyeba moto oyo ya masapo oyo euti na Coran?
clues: Napesamaki nguya mpe bopusi na mabele na Motema mawa mingi
Nasalaki mobembo tii na esika oyo moi ebimaka mpe epai elalaka
Nakómaki epai ya bato oyo bakokaki mpenza te kokanga ntina ya liloba moko
Bapesaki ngai etinda ya kotonga epekiseli monene na kosaleláká ebende
Nakangaki esika oyo ezalaki kati na bangomba mibale ya mabangamabanga na bibende oyo enyangwaki
Nazalaki anzelu te to profeta te, kasi mosali oyo Allah apesaki ye boboto

identity.label: Nazali Nani?
options: Dhu al-Qarnayn (Moto oyo azali na maseke mibale) .
Mokonzi Suléima (Salomo) .
Mosakoli Dhul-Kifl
Dhu al-Nun (Moninga ya mbisi) .
Anzelu ya Barrière
identity.answer: Dhu al-Qarnayn (Moto oyo azali na maseke mibale) .

trial.label: Mosala Monene
options: Kotonga ndako molai mpo na kokende na likoló
Kotonga barrière ya ebende ya monene contre Yajuj na Majuj
Kokela kiti ya bokonzi ya wolo mpo na kosambisa
Kotimola libulu ya mozindo mpo na bayengebene
Kotonga masuwa na ntango ya mpela monene
trial.answer: Kotonga barrière ya ebende ya monene contre Yajuj na Majuj

location.label: Paramètre oyo esalemi
options: Mokili ya Uzaire kati na bibale mibale
Esika oyo moi ebimaka mpe liziba ya pɔtɔpɔtɔ ya moindo
Lobwaku mosantu ya Makkah
Esobe ya Madyan
Esanga ya Chypre
location.answer: Esika oyo moi ebimaka mpe liziba ya pɔtɔpɔtɔ ya moindo

outcome.label: Elaka ya Bonzambe
options: Paradis ya seko epesami mbala moko
Ekólo yango ebebisamaki na mopɛpɛ makasi
Epekiseli ekowumela kino Mokolo ya Kosambisama
Bonsomi na liwa mpo na bandimi banso
Bokonzi ya seko oyo ezangi nsuka
outcome.answer: Epekiseli ekowumela kino Mokolo ya Kosambisama

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
